scope: Inert five-region local review preview with revision comparison, public-only evidence projection, stale binding protection, and explicit working/verified package status

red_evidence.reason: the local review-page renderer and review template were absent

green_evidence.environment: Darwin 27.0.0 arm64; Node.js v24.18.0; Google Chrome 153.0.8010.52

assertions: the local HTML has exactly five status, content, diff, sources, and reports regions
working draft and verified package are visibly distinct states
private sources and private report summaries are excluded from the generated public preview
a stale requested revision blocks rendering and a stale report is labeled without attaching its summary
the preview contains no script, form, button, or remote active resource and real Chromium records zero HTTP resource requests

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
